title: Adam Szudi, ranked 215th, upsets world No 15 Shunsuke Togami as Dortmund whitewash Ochsenhausen
seo_title: Szudi upsets Togami as Saarbrücken go second in TTBL
description: Adam Szudi beat world No 15 Shunsuke Togami 12-10 in the fifth, Filip Zeljko beat Dimitrij Ovtcharov and Saarbrücken went second in the Bundesliga.
standfirst: Ochsenhausen's 3-0 defeat in Dortmund let Saarbrücken move second in the Tischtennis Bundesliga, while Filip Zeljko beat Dimitrij Ovtcharov and Werder won in the doubles again.
body: Adam Szudi, ranked 215th in the world, beat the world No 15 Shunsuke Togami in a deciding game on Friday as Borussia Dortmund beat TTF Liebherr Ochsenhausen 3-0 in the Tischtennis Bundesliga.

The 30-year-old Hungarian won 11-5, 9-11, 11-3, 7-11, 12-10 against a Japanese player ranked 200 places above him. It was the second rubber of the night and put Dortmund 2-0 up, after Wim Verdonschot had beaten Ochsenhausen's 18-year-old Tiago Abiodun 11-5, 12-14, 11-8, 11-13, 11-5. João Geraldo then beat Iulian Chirita 12-10, 6-11, 11-7, 11-9 to complete the whitewash.

It was Ochsenhausen's second defeat in a row, after [TTC Bad Homburg ended their perfect start](/news/tischtennis-bundesliga-2026-27-matchday-7-bad-homburg-beat-ochsenhausen-andras.html) a week earlier, and it cost them second place. 1. FC Saarbrücken beat TTC Zugbrücke Grenzau 3-1 on Sunday to draw level with them on 12 points and move above them on games won and lost.

Dimitrij Ovtcharov was beaten by a lower-ranked player at home in Fulda on the same night. The world No 21 beat Daniel Habesohn 12-10, 3-11, 11-6, 12-10 in the opening rubber, and Jonathan Groth's win over Bastian Steger put TTC RhönSprudel Fulda-Maberzell 2-1 up against TSV Bad Königshofen.

Filip Zeljko, the world No 127, then came from 2-1 down to beat the 38-year-old 14-12, 3-11, 8-11, 11-9, 11-7, his second win of the night after beating Ruwen Filus in four games. Habesohn and Steger won the deciding doubles 3-1 against Groth and Fanbo Meng, and Bad Königshofen won 3-2.
## Stumper wins twice in Bad Homburg

Post SV Mühlhausen won 3-1 at Bad Homburg, where Kay Stumper beat Ivor Ban 14-12 in the fifth game and then Csaba Andras 5-11, 11-6, 14-12, 13-11. Ovidiu Ionescu had beaten Andras in five games in the opener. Bad Homburg's only point came from Juan Perez, who came from two games down to beat Marcos Freitas 7-11, 9-11, 11-7, 11-5, 11-4.

The two defeats left Andras on 11 wins and four losses, and on Sunday Fan Zhendong moved past him to the top of the league's player rankings with his eighth win from eight, as [Borussia Düsseldorf beat ASC Grünwettersbach 3-0](/news/fan-zhendong-borussia-dusseldorf-return-unbeaten-bundesliga-2026.html) to stay four points clear at the top.
## Werder win in the doubles again

Werder Bremen won 3-2 at TTC Schwalbe Bergneustadt on Sunday, the same score and the same way as when they knocked Bergneustadt out of the German Cup in August: in the deciding doubles. Kirill Gerassimenko beat Romain Ruiz and Benedikt Duda, both in four games, and Mattias Karlsson and Irvin Bertrand beat Ruiz and Cedric Meissner 11-7, 11-5, 8-11, 11-9 to finish it.

Bergneustadt had led 2-1 after Duda beat Karlsson and Adrien Rassenfosse beat Bertrand 15-13 in the fourth game. Karlsson started well against Duda but was then troubled by a painful blister on his foot, buten un binnen reported.

"That was a great team performance from the boys. It feels very, very good, because at times we were almost dead. But Kirill saved us today with two strong singles," Cristian Tamas, Werder's coach, told buten un binnen (translated from German). Werder are fourth on 10 points.

In Saarbrücken, Patrick Franziska beat England's Samuel Walker 3-1 and Alvaro Robles beat Martin Allegro, while Feng Yi-Hsin kept Grenzau in the tie by beating Albert Vilardell 3-1. Franziska, the world No 11, then beat Feng to seal it. Saarbrücken lost the first leg of their [Champions League last-16 tie](/news/ettu-champions-league-men-2026-27-last-16-first-legs-roskilde-lille-upsets.html) 3-2 at Lille two days earlier.

Saarbrücken play the leaders Düsseldorf in Trier on Sunday 22 November at 2.30pm UK time, Fan Zhendong's first match against his old club. Ochsenhausen host Werder Bremen on Monday 23 November at 6pm, the same night that Mühlhausen play Dortmund at 5.30pm.
